start.command: if [ ! -S /tmp/nvim ]; then echo '[-_-] Note: Start listening Neovim with: vl (optional for enhanced integration)'; fi

tool_decision.command: if [ "$tool_name" = "Edit" ] || [ "$tool_name" = "Write" ] || [ "$tool_name" = "MultiEdit" ]; then if [ ! -S /tmp/nvim ]; then echo ''; echo '⚠️  WARNING: No listening Neovim found!'; echo '   Start with: vl (in separate terminal)'; echo '   Then you can follow edits in real-time'; echo ''; echo 'Proceeding with edit anyway...'; echo ''; fi; fi

tool_result.command: if [ "$tool_name" = "Edit" ] || [ "$tool_name" = "Write" ] || [ "$tool_name" = "MultiEdit" ]; then echo "[DEBUG] Hook triggered for $tool_name" && FILE_PATH=$(echo "$hook_input" | grep -o '/[^"]*\.[a-zA-Z0-9]*' | head -1) && echo "[DEBUG] File: $FILE_PATH" && if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && [ -S /tmp/nvim ] && [[ "$FILE_PATH" != *"claude-code"* ]]; then echo "[DEBUG] Executing nvim commands" && nvim --server /tmp/nvim --remote-send '<C-h>:e '$FILE_PATH'<CR><C-l>' && echo "[^_^] Updated left editor: $(basename $FILE_PATH)"; else echo "[DEBUG] Hook conditions not met"; fi; fi
